items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: He really did talk about me... I had the best PR man in the world... Amazing man. I really thought about him until I hit upon just how amazing he was

ctx.x: Amazing man. I really thought about him until I hit upon just how amazing he was, and it stopped me. I want to tell you about that.
I can’t believe how fast this time has passed.
